cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A uses its festival pupil old record-keeping lessons and present decisiveness to obtain dated approval that cannot later disappear into a changed recollection.
confusable: Not trying to prohibit changing a decision: A insists the original yes be traceable when changed.
comparison: Past reversal of festival approval versus accommodating limited-duration boundary consent.
